system.summary: 1583 Spanish Milanese chancery cipher (matching Tomokiyo's web summary of Philip II's Cg.12 at https://cryptiana.web.fc2.com/code/spanish3.htm; period key sheet unverified): factored syllabary combining 19 single-consonant bases, attested consonant-cluster bases in 23-34 (25 unattested; 28 and 30 singletons), inflected stem 60=auis-, 5 right-attached vowel marks (|,e,+,.,@), 4 coda marks (',^,,,:), gemination cross (* -> ll, rr, ss, ff mechanically), vowel+m dots (8., 7., 5_m, 14|., 96.), f=e substitute letter, literal-numeral overbars (~), and an unglossed 2-4 letter and underlined-numeral nomenclator.

diacritics.note: Right-attached vowel marks (|,e,+,.,@), coda marks (',^,,,:), gemination cross (*), under-dot (_m), literal-numeral overbar (~), cancellation circle (°), and nomenclator underline (=).

system.doubled_letters: special sign (* gemination cross: mechanically emits ll, rr, ss, ff; zero nn emitted mechanically)
system.sibling_key: Both BYU Vault MSS 771 (#2077, Aug-Sep 1583) and companion Vault MSS 518 f. 3 item 2 (#2518, 5 Oct 1583) use the identical 1583 Spanish factored syllabary (matching Tomokiyo's Cg.12 note at https://cryptiana.web.fc2.com/code/spanish3.htm); pre-revision #2077 key transfers blind to #2518 (286/323 = 88.54%, z_LM=+8.54/+17.05) and revised joint key.tsv maps 288/323 (89.16%, z_LM=+8.54/+17.36). DECODE R9318 and BYU Vault MSS 518 f. 4 item 24 (pointer 54152) remain untested.

solution.what: Inventoried all 27 items of BYU Vault MSS 771 (12 cipher letters, 0 key sheets/glosses, clear Duque de Joyosa in Item 7) and staged companion #2518 (Vault MSS 518 f. 3 item 2); compared 1570s-1590s Philip II ciphers in cyphersolver_repo and Tomokiyo's Cryptiana survey (https://cryptiana.web.fc2.com/code/spanish3.htm, sections Cp.30 and Cg.12; DECODE R9318 not tested).

Produced factored transcriptions of 5 selected #2077 items (Items 6, 16, 21 in full + inline transitions of Item 19 + 2-line excerpt of Item 26: 170 lines, 3,116 tokens after 19 revised lines at 4x zoom in transcript_2077_v2.txt) and blind held-out #2518 (19 lines, 323 tokens in transcript_2518.txt, 3 water-stain lacunae marked [stain] in diplomatic_2518.txt; 431 distinct surface types combined).

Ran letter-level homophonic+null Golden Age Spanish synthetic control on held-out mendoza1589 f14 (scripts/synthetic_control_1583.py: 791 tokens, 44 symbols, zero overlap): LM/ch -1.8276, WordHit 0.974, Shuf-Key z_LM=+19.81, Shuf-Strm z_LM=+38.32 (p=0.0050; DummyAllE=FAIL). Note: control encrypts individual letters rather than a factored syllabary.

Assisted factored SA on the cipher stream alone (scripts/solve_cg12.py fixing f=e without clear cribs, scripts/refine_cg12.py) followed by manual contextual analysis and 4x scan checks recovered the factored syllabary (5 vowel marks, 4 coda marks, * gemination, vowel+m dots, f=e, 19 consonant bases, attested 23-34 cluster bases, 60=auis-, and 11 short structural codes) covering 92.23% of #2077 tokens (2,874/3,116) and 88.54% pre-revision / 89.16% revised joint on #2518.

Unboosted order-5 200-shuffle dynamic validation with clm.norm j->i/v->u folding (validate.py -> validation.txt; var > 1e-12 guard; mutated all-'e' and all-'a' key negative controls without CLI flags both returned FAIL exit=1): #2077 v2 (6,196 chars) LM/ch -2.1567 (z=+9.13 keys / +53.42 streams, WordHit 0.9444, p=0.0050); pre-revision #2518 transfer (286/323, 632 chars) LM/ch -2.2090 (z=+8.54 / +17.05, p=0.0050); revised joint #2518 (288/323, 638 chars) LM/ch -2.2203 (z=+8.54 / +17.36, p=0.0050). Cyphersolver standard order-4 refitting test (docs/_validate.py): #2077 PASS (-2.074 vs -2.385), short #2518 UNDERDETERMINED (-2.178 vs -1.980).

Unedited mechanical decryptions (decryption_2077.txt 92.23%, decryption_2518.txt 89.16%) and post-audit strict cipher-words-only reading audit (word_audit.py and v10_relabel.py match identically with clear_markup=⟨⟩ after restoring Item 21 p. 2 L26-27 to p. 3 L01 and bracketing all repairs, absorbed open signs, and Grade-3 singletons): #2077 1,272/1,768 sure cipher words (0.719, 496 holes); #2518 128/196 sure cipher words (0.653, 68 holes); combined 1,400/1,964 (0.713) -> read in part.

outcome.method_basis: The factored syllabary and short-word layer were recovered from the cipher token stream of #2077 via assisted SA (f=e seeded; no clear passages used as solver cribs, with inline clear framing checked afterward for context) and manual/scan refinement, and confirmed by blind pre-revision transfer to held-out companion #2518 (88.54% mapped; 89.16% under revised joint key.tsv).

validation.notes: Custom order-5 DenseLM ('es-golden-age-nospace', unboosted lang/lexicons/es.json.gz, clm.norm j->i/v->u, var > 1e-12 guard; mutated all-'e' and all-'a' key.tsv negative controls without CLI flags both returned DECISION: FAIL exit=1). Headline numbers above are #2077 v2 alone (3,116 tokens, 413 types, 2,874/3,116 = 92.23% mapped, 6,196 chars, WordHit 0.9444, Cov4 z=+8.53/+30.26, Cov5 z=+8.30/+39.23, p=0.0050; combined inventory across #2077+#2518 is 3,439 tokens and 431 types). Companion #2518 is reported separately in validation.txt: pre-revision transfer (286/323 = 88.54%, 632 chars) LM/ch -2.2090, WordHit 0.9330, Shuf-Key z=+8.54, Shuf-Strm z=+17.05 (p=0.0050); revised joint key.tsv (288/323 = 89.16%, 638 chars) LM/ch -2.2203, WordHit 0.9333, Shuf-Key z=+8.54, Shuf-Strm z=+17.36 (p=0.0050). Cyphersolver standard order-4 refitting test (docs/_validate.py) separately returns PASS on #2077 (-2.074 vs best of 6 shuffled-ciphertext refits -2.385) and UNDERDETERMINED on short #2518 (-2.178 vs -1.980).

outcome.fraction_read_source: reading_2077.md (1,272/1,768 = 0.719, 496 holes, clear_markup=⟨⟩) and reading_2518.md (128/196 = 0.653, 68 holes, clear_markup=⟨⟩) measured identically by word_audit.py and research/reading_audit/v10_relabel.py (combined 1,400/1,964 = 0.713 sure cipher words).

texts.label: BYU Vault MSS 771 (catalogue 2077, Terranova -> Sfondrati, 5 selected items: Items 6, 16, 21 + inline Item 19 + 2-line excerpt Item 26, Aug-Sep 1583)
texts.summary: Governor of Milan Terranova writes to Ambassador Sfondrati in Turin across Aug-Sep 1583 on the arrival of Anne, Duc de Joyeuse (independently in clear in Item 7) and news of the Duke of Nevers, reinforcing Turin's garrison with infantry, refuting Asti troop rumors while confirming secret contingency plans in case of Duke Charles Emmanuel I's death, expressing astonishment at a reported offer of 100,000 [ducados] of income to Marshal Henri de Montmorency (corroborated by Joan Davies, AGS Estado 1258 ff. 165-166, Alessandro Constantino and Ferrante Pagano), and proposing to send the original Montmorency draft and signed note to Philip II via Gian Andrea Doria's {ca^?} and Terranova's son Don Pedro de Aragón (including the restored clause on Ferrante traveling in Don Pedro's company) while querying an Italian marginal clause on 2-3 maritime fortresses.

texts.label: BYU Vault MSS 518 f. 3 item 2 (catalogue 2518, Terranova -> Sfondrati, Milan, 5 Oct 1583 — companion witness)
texts.summary: Held out blind during #2077 recovery (88.54% pre-revision transfer; 89.16% revised joint key.tsv), Terranova coordinates 5,000 currency units by 10 October, explains why urgent royal matters delayed dispatching the courier to [Madrid] with the [packet], and writes to Genoa to [Ambassador] Don Pedro de [Mendoza] so the frigate is [captained] by a trustworthy {hol?}; a clear postscript cites Pompeo della Croce on a traveler crossing the St. Gotthard Pass toward Varese.

outcome.notes: Factored syllabary and short-word layer of a 1583 Spanish Milanese chancery cipher (matching Tomokiyo's Cg.12 note at https://cryptiana.web.fc2.com/code/spanish3.htm) recovered from #2077 (5 selected items of BYU Vault MSS 771) and verified by transfer to companion #2518 (BYU Vault MSS 518 f. 3 item 2); both documents classify honestly as read in part (0.719 and 0.653, combined 0.713) with all open nomenclators, Grade-3 singletons, absorbed open signs, and repairs explicitly bracketed.
